# 2 Baruch Chapter 36 — The EMET Bible (Literal)
**Translator:** EMET | **Source:** Syriac MS (Codex Ambrosianus 7a1) | **Section:** Third Fast and Vision

---

**36:1** And-I-lay-down and-I-slept, and-I-saw a-vision in-the-night.

**36:2** And-behold, a-forest-of-trees stood-upon a-plain, and-there-were-large-and-lofty cedars, and-there-were-around-them thorns and-brambles.

**36:3** And-there-was-on-the-other-side a-vine of-grapevines, lowly and-humble; and-out-of-it came-a-stream-of-water.

**36:4** And-that-vine grew, and-it-came to-the-forest; and-in-a-short-time it-filled-the-whole-forest, and-uprooted all-the-cedars; and-it-threw-down and-scattered all-that-was-tall.

**36:5** And-the-head-of-the-cedars which-had-been-thrown-down — it [the vine] dried-up that-head, and-laid-it-low on-the-ground.

**36:6** And-the-rest-of-the-cedars lay-flat, and-they-fell-at-the-root-of-the-vine which-had-thrown-them-down; and-no-one of-them was-remaining.

**36:7** And-that-vine grew and-became-exalted, and-became-the-lord-of all-the-forest; and-out-of-it the-water-flowed more-abundantly-than-before, and-there-[came to-it] all-the-pleasant-trees-of-the-earth which-were-delight-of-the-eye.

**36:8** And-it-spread-itself over-all-the-plain, and-the-whole-earth was-filled with-its-fruit.

**36:9** Then-I-saw this and-I-arose.

---

*EMET notes: Translated from the Syriac Codex Ambrosianus. The great forest-vine vision: a forest of cedars (= successive world empires) is destroyed by a humble vine (= the Messiah/messianic kingdom). The interpretation follows in chs. 39-40. The lowly vine that overthrows the great cedars is a classic inversion-of-power theme.*
